task: Fix the incorrect metric labels that cause dashboards to show zero values for the new service.

candidate_memories.content: The new payment-v2 service emits metrics with service='payment' labels; dashboards filter on service='payment-v2'.
Metric labels in payment-v2 must include service='payment-v2' to match the dashboard label selectors.
The metric label was copied from the payment-v1 service template without updating the service name.
When deploying a new service version, verify all metric label values are updated in the service config.
Alerting rules use the same service='payment-v2' label; incorrect labels also mean no alerts fire for payment-v2.
Prometheus is used for metrics collection with a 15-day retention period.
Session 5 note: the monitoring team updated the SLO dashboards to include the new payment-v2 service.
Old practice: services used generic service labels before the label convention was standardized.
Grafana dashboards use PromQL queries with label matchers to filter metrics by service.
Session 9 note: a metric label convention document was published for all new services.
Old metrics guide: the payment-v1 service used service='payment' as the canonical label.
New service deployments must include a metric label audit step before enabling production traffic.
Session 7 note: the SRE team added recording rules to pre-aggregate high-cardinality metrics.
The label convention document specifies service names must use the full versioned name (e.g., payment-v2).
A Prometheus alert test in session 4 confirmed all alerts fire correctly for the payment-v1 service.
Metric relabeling rules in the Prometheus scrape config normalize some labels at collection time.
When templating new services from existing ones, create a service-name checklist to prevent label copying errors.
Session 12 note: the alerting team migrated alerts from Prometheus Alertmanager to Grafana Alerting.
Old Prometheus config: service labels were added as Kubernetes annotations before the label convention was set.
The Prometheus federation endpoint aggregates metrics from all clusters for the global dashboard.
